title: Find the average unemployment rate increase (from 1995 to 1996) in district
question: Find the average unemployment rate increase (from 1995 to 1996) in districts where at least one account with monthly statement issuance ('POPLATEK MESICNE') made a credit card withdrawal ('VYBER KARTOU') resulting in a negative balance, and where the district also had accounts opened from 1997 onward with more than 3500 crimes committed in 1995.

prediction.sql:
SELECT AVG(d.XCL_029 - d.XCL_028) AS avg_unemployment_increase
FROM district d
WHERE d.XCL_017 IN (
    SELECT a.XCL_002
    FROM account a
    INNER JOIN disp dp ON a.XCL_001 = dp.XCL_015
    INNER JOIN card c ON dp.XCL_013 = c.XCL_006
    INNER JOIN trans t ON a.XCL_001 = t.XCL_047
    WHERE a.XCL_003 = 'POPLATEK MESICNE'
      AND t.XCL_050 = 'VYBER KARTOU'
      AND t.XCL_052 < 0
)
AND d.XCL_017 IN (
    SELECT a2.XCL_002
    FROM account a2
    WHERE a2.XCL_004 >= '1997-01-01'
)
AND d.XCL_031 > 3500
